title: cost-optimization: autotune default batching/caching thresholds, quant profiles, and unit-econ tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: We want safer out-of-the-box defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching and a standardized way to recommend quantization profiles per model, plus tooling to compute route-level unit economics so customers can make data-driven decisions. This PR implements: 1) new autotune defaults that choose batching window, max batch size, and cache TTLs based on historical seq-length distributions and latency SLOs; 2) per-model quantization profile catalog and a selector that prefers quant profiles based on quality-recall targets and HW availability; 3) a new unit-economics CLI (tools/uecon) that ingests route metrics and outputs per-token cost, recommended batching/caching/quant profiles and projected savings; 4) tests and operator docs. The description below is a single continuous narrative summarizing changes, testing, and rollout notes. Changes are conservative by default and guarded by the feature flag 'autotune-defaults'. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan.
commits: feat(autotune): add default batching and caching profiles and selector
perf(runtime): KV-prefetch heuristics to reduce cold-start latency for cached prefixes
feat(quant): add per-model quantization profiles and selector with compatibility mapping
tools(uecon): add CLI to compute per-route unit economics and recommendation engine
test: add unit and integration tests for autotune logic and CLI
docs: operator guide for autotune defaults and uecon workflow
review_comments: Miguel Torres (reviewer): The default max_batch_size looks aggressive for short-sequence workloads; could cause tail latency spikes under bursty traffic. Please add adaptive cap based on median seq length.
Asha Patel (author): Added adaptive cap that scales max_batch_size down when median seq length < 64 and when 95th latency exceeds SLO. See heuristics.go change and unit tests.
Lina Zhang (reviewer): Quantization profiles look good; need a fallback path for hardware that doesn't support 4-bit kernels yet.
Asha Patel (author): Added compatibility mapping and fallback to int8 profiles; CLI now reports compatibility and expected quality impact.
Evan Brooks (reviewer): Unit-econ CLI is useful but please ensure CLI does not leak internal cost units in public builds and add a flag to redact internal IDs.
Asha Patel (author): Added --redact flag and sanitized default output. CLI tests updated.
Lina Zhang (approver): Approving after small nits fixed in docs and added an example in tools/uecon/README.md.
CI Bot: All required checks passed; automated canary dry-run succeeded on staging cluster.
merge_summary: Merged via squash merge on 2025-01-22. Merge commit: abcdef1234567890. Rollout: feature flag 'autotune-defaults' enabled to 5% canary on 2025-01-23, monitoring dashboards and alerts added for latency and cost regressions. Ops plan: 48h canary then step to 25% if no regressions.
release_notes: Added conservative autotune defaults for batching and prefix/KV caching, a per-model quantization profile catalog and selector with compatibility fallbacks, and a unit-economics CLI to compute per-route cost and make recommendations. Defaults are feature-flagged behind 'autotune-defaults' and rolled out gradually. See docs/operator/autotune.md for operator guidance and tools/uecon/README.md for usage.
